title: Vampire Vape Pinkman Longfill E-Liquid - 20ml
description: Vampire Vape Pinkman Longfill allows you to build your perfect e-liquid from the ground up, using one of the most iconic flavour profiles in vaping history. This concentrate delivers the definitive Pinkman experience, anchored by a vibrant foundation of sweet Red Berries. You will immediately recognise the juicy notes of Strawberry and Raspberry, which provide a naturally sweet and fruity inhale. To elevate this berry base, the blend incorporates those signature zesty undertones of Citrus and Tropical Fruit. Often identified as a hint of Grapefruit or Lemon, this sharp, tangy finish cuts through the sweetness, creating a layered and complex vape that remains refreshing all day long. It is the authentic taste that made Vampire Vape famous, now available in a format that puts you in complete control. What is a Longfill? A Longfill is a 60ml bottle containing 20ml of highly concentrated flavouring (suspended in 100% PG). The remaining 40ml of space is left empty for you to add your own combination of Nicotine Shots and VG/PG Base Mix. Why choose a Longfill over a Shortfill? Higher Nicotine Strengths: Unlike Shortfills, which are generally limited to a final strength of 3mg, Longfills allow you to mix an e-liquid with strengths of 3mg, 6mg, 9mg, or even 12mg, depending on how many nicotine shots you add. Customisable Ratio: You control the final VG/PG ratio. By adjusting your added base mix, you can create a High-VG blend for sub-ohm clouds or a 50/50 blend for MTL starter kits. How to Mix: Remove the bottle cap and nozzle. Add your required number of Nicotine Shots and/or VG/PG Base Mix to fill the bottle. Secure the nozzle and cap back on. Shake the bottle vigorously for at least 60 seconds to ensure the concentrate blends fully with the base. For the best flavour, you may choose to let the e-liquid steep for a short period, though fruit flavours like Pinkman are often ready to vape immediately after mixing.
